items.title: Bungie Unveils Bishop Runner Shell Cinematic Trailer Ahead of December 8 Update
items.summary: Bungie released a cinematic trailer on November 24 introducing Bishop, a new melee-focused Runner Shell described as a jet-propelled robot samurai with an extendable arm blade and leg-mounted thrusters. Bishop becomes playable on December 8 when the Symbiosis update launches, which also kicks off a free Open Play Week running December 8 through 15.
items.credibility_note: PC Gamer is an established gaming outlet reporting directly on Bungie's official trailer.

items.title: Marathon Adding Gender-Swapped Runner Shells, Starting With Silhouette
items.summary: Bungie confirmed that Marathon will introduce gender-swapped versions of existing Runner Shells, beginning with Silhouette, a female variant of the Assassin shell. The free customization option arrives with the December 8 Symbiosis update, with both versions sharing identical abilities but different appearance and voice work.
items.credibility_note: Forbes contributor Paul Tassi has an established track record covering Bungie and Destiny-related news.

items.title: Context: Marathon's Symbiosis Update Set for December 8 With Major New Modes
items.summary: This preview was originally published November 10, 2026 by PC Gamer. It detailed Bungie's upcoming Symbiosis update, including a permanent co-op PvE mode called Expedition, an experimental 3v3 Team Deathmatch beta, an expanded Perimeter zone, and a new social hub called Limbo, all arriving December 8 alongside a free Open Play Week.
items.credibility_note: PC Gamer is an established outlet; included as context to explain the scope of the update that today's Bishop and gender-swap shell news belongs to.

items.title: Context: Marathon's December Update Seen as Make-or-Break Moment
items.summary: This analysis was originally published November 10, 2026 by PushSquare. It described the Symbiosis update, delayed from September, as a critical test for Marathon given steep player decline since launch, with December and March 2027 framed as key recovery milestones for Bungie.
items.credibility_note: PushSquare is an established games outlet providing analysis based on Bungie's own statements rather than rumor.
